verdict.rationale: YYLO isolates agent work from the protected target. `task start` freezes the protected SHA and creates a dedicated branch/worktree, preflight is read-only, and merges compose in a private detached candidate with expected-old ref protection. Benchmark candidates also run in private fresh repositories rather than shared worktrees. This is Git-level isolation from the protected branch, not a documented sandbox environment that separates test data from production data. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test environment for runtime and data isolation, any mention of production-data protection beyond Git refs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
